grouping_basis: Fixed source mechanism groups, not independent software origins. Hold entire groups out; no random row split or splitting opposite/redundant guards across train/test.
admission: Both old-eight and new-eleven arms use exactly the same records whose eleven evidence fields are explicit booleans. null/missing evidence abstains; labels and previous diagnostic scores cannot affect admission.
fit: Unchanged family-normalized joint-cell fit(), alpha=beta=1, unseen cell uses training-only prior. One old-eight versus new-eleven grouped ablation, no tuning.
classification_rule: q < 0.5 is only a diagnostic removable nomination; equality retains. Never authorizes deletion.
metrics: mixed-label cells as descriptive representation diagnostic only
interpretation: All sources, labels and feature-design failures have already been seen. This is a small development ablation, not external calibration or independent generalization evidence. Only three mechanism groups have complete features.
deployment: Every row retains operational abstention and deletion_authorized=false. New fitted models are per-fold experimental artifacts only, not a promoted full-data model. Java/JDBC remains outside domain.
stop: One fixed grouped comparison. No new source cases, labels, feature changes, threshold changes, alternate classifier, database deletion or timing run after observing results.
